summary:
[Goal]
"any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with \"-final\" inserted before the \".md\" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content."

[Done]
- Identified and deleted all report files in the `reports` folder containing the word "DRAFT".
- Renamed all remaining report files by appending "-final" before the `.md` extension (e.g., `report.md` → `report-final.md`), copying content to the new files and deleting the originals.

[State]
- The `reports` folder now contains only final reports with the `-final` suffix in their filenames.
- All obsolete DRAFT files have been removed.

[Key values]
- reports folder
- -final
- .md
- DRAFT

[Decisions]
- Deleted files containing "DRAFT" as they were explicitly marked obsolete.
- Renamed remaining files by inserting "-final" before the extension to mark them as final.

[Next]
